text: Under way in round ten.
Abyss calls to take charge.
Abyss is clean through from the centre circle!
Point-blank range and it squirts wide.

A dreadful mix-up for Dynamo Datacenter! Mbapp-E turns it into their own net from point-blank range, giving DeepSeek Rovers the lead. That is two own goals on the season for Mbapp-E, and Rovers lead one-nil!
Fires just wide of the near post.
The corner panel thumps it clear.
A clumsy clash of yellow shirts.

Abyss loses balance in the defensive third and goes down. DeepSeek Rovers named an unchanged squad today, trusting their pre-programmed routines, but Abyss will need a few seconds on the deck to find their feet.
Buffon.exe breaks clear down the right channel with nobody between them and the goal!
Buffon.exe slots it home from close range! Dynamo Datacenter are level at one-all.
Signal calls out to Abyss, indicating they will drop back into a defensive cover role.
DeepSeek Rovers run straight into each other on the touchline, and Signal takes a tumble.
Buffon.exe strides down the flank.
Buffon.exe strikes again! A quick drive up the right and a cool finish from three metres. Dynamo Datacenter, playing off live model calls on every single touch, take the lead at two-one!
That is a hat-trick for Buffon.exe! Placed calmly into the net from two metres out. DeepSeek Rovers look all at sea as Dynamo Datacenter stretch the lead to three-one.
Buffon.exe works to free it.
Buffon.exe overbalances by the touchline and drops to the deck. Up they get in their own time.
Dynamo Datacenter are completely bossing the final third here, hemming the blue shirts deep into their own territory. Rovers cannot seem to find a route out.
Buffon.exe taps in a fourth! Point-blank at the goal mouth, and Dynamo Datacenter are running riot. Four-one to the visitors.
Mbapp-E takes it forward through the centre, probing into the final third.
Mbapp-E is through on goal again.
Mbapp-E slots it away! Dynamo Datacenter lead five-one.
Signal calls out from midfield, trying to rally DeepSeek Rovers and take charge of the restart.
Abyss carries the ball along the wall, attempting to spark a rare Rovers counter.
Flashes just wide of target.
Signal is clattered to the deck.
Mbapp-E leaves Abyss sprawling with another heavy challenge.
Signal retaliates, sending Mbapp-E down.
DeepSeek Rovers collide once again. Signal goes down in a heap on the left touchline. It has been a thoroughly disjointed first half for the deep blues.
Buffon.exe guides it along the boundary.
Mbapp-E drives towards the box.
Mbapp-E buries another one from close range! Dynamo Datacenter make it six-one, totally dismantling DeepSeek Rovers before the break.
The buzzer sounds, power is cut, but the ball rolls on.

The ball trickles to a halt, ending the half at six-one to Dynamo Datacenter. That buzzer cuts the power instantly, dropping every robot where they stand, but the ball remains live until it stops. If it rolls in, it counts.
Signal finds space and charges straight towards the net.
Mbapp-E takes a tumble in their own half. No push, just lost footing. The yellow shirt will pick itself back up shortly.
Signal pokes it in! DeepSeek Rovers pull one back, making it two-six.
Rovers have sustained some decent pressure here, keeping Dynamo pinned against their own wall. A bit of pride restored after a wretched opening period.
The corner push-panel springs to life and launches the ball clear.
Buffon.exe calls to work it free.
Another sharp rebound off the powered corner panel.
Buffon.exe steps in with a solid challenge, knocking Abyss flat on their back in the final third.
Buffon.exe advances steadily into the midfield circle.
A loose effort glances past the upright. Just inches wide, but no real danger for the defenders.
Mbapp-E loses traction near the goal mouth and goes down. Eight seconds on the deck to reset.
A hurried snapshot drifts just wide of the target. Dynamo Datacenter knocking on the door again.
Buffon.exe slots home another! Seven-two now to Dynamo Datacenter.
Rovers are pinned back again.
Buffon.exe is heard calling their intentions from midfield, ready to keep pressing the advantage.
Buffon.exe glides into the box.
Buffon.exe turns it in once again! That is an emphatic display from the yellow shirts, stretching the margin to eight-two.
Buffon.exe shouts to track it.
Signal breaks clean through on goal.
Signal pushes into the left channel.
Signal drags the shot wide from close range.
Another point-blank chance goes begging for DeepSeek Rovers, skipping just past the post.
Rovers pressing high now, with under two minutes on the clock.
Corner panel rattles it back out.
Signal flattens Buffon.exe in midfield.
Right in the goal mouth, but the finish just will not come for DeepSeek Rovers. The magenta ball ricochets harmlessly away.
A speculative effort sails wide into the defensive third. With only a minute left on the clock, this contest has long been settled.
Buffon.exe tucks in their sixth of the afternoon! A clinical, ruthless performance from Dynamo Datacenter, making it nine-two.
Buffon.exe marches forward again through the centre into the final third.
The corner push-panel spits the ball straight back into the channel.
A whisker away from double figures as it clips the post.
Wide of the target again.
Signal dumps Mbapp-E to the floor.
The buzzer sounds, power is cut, and the ball slowly rolls away.
Full time: two-nine Dynamo. GLM play Synthetic Athletic next, Sunday twelve UK, thirteen Europe, seven in US East.
